img_012.text: INDIANINSTITUTEOFTECHNOLOGY BOMBAY INDUSTRIALRESEARCH AND CONSULTANCY CENTER(IRCC) IIT BOMBAY RESEARCHINTERNSHIP2023-24 Indian Institute ofTechnology Bombay (IIT Bombay) offers opportunity for Research Internship to eligible students for early exposure ofResearch and Development (R&D) in Science, Technology and related emerging areas. This full-time research internship is awarded to bright students every academic year on challenging research projects to be floated by the IT Bombay faculty. Selection of the Interns are done in response to the applications made by the. prospecting candidates on the basis oftheir respective academic record and performance in the interview to be conducted by the respective faculty member ofthe Institute. The duration ofthe IRCC-IR-internship 2023-24 will be for a period between four to six months (from December 2023 and June 2024) Eligibility: The prospecting applicant is required to - be in the Secondyear of his/her Master degree program, or third / fourth year of his/her Bachelordegreeprogram. submit applicationinaccordancewithhis/herbranch/disciplineofstudyandinaccordance with theproject requirement specified by the ITBombayFaculty (Internship Guide). be among the top10% in all theprevious years inhis/her disciplinein theCollege/ University / Institute. A certificate from the principal (in the prescribed format) to this effectisrequiredtobesubmitted alongwiththeapplication. a full-timestudentwhile applyingand till thecompletionof theInternshipprogramme. S/He may submit a partial project report before (e.g., in April) the completion of the Internship(e.g., in June) ifthe academic calendar of his/her College / Institute / University requires him/her to do so, with the due prior consent oftheInternship Guide of IITBombay. be able to work full-time for the Internship programme. Part-time internship is not allowed. A certificatefrom the principal to the effect that there is no coursework requirement during the internship period has to be submitted at the time of application. Detailed information about the IRCC-IR-Internship programme is available on the Institute website -https://www.ircc.itb.ac.in/IRCC-Webpage/ITBInternship/. For any enquiry you may send e-mail to internship@ircc.iitb.ac.in Withbestregards Sr.Assistant Registrar, IRCC
